title: CPE (Common Platform Enumeration)
summary: CPE is a standardized naming scheme for IT products: cpe:2.3:{part}:{vendor}:{product}:{version}:{update}:{edition}:{language}:{sw_edition}:{target_sw}:{target_hw}:{other}. Part: a (application), o (OS), h (hardware). Used in vulnerability databases (NVD) to identify affected products.

notes: CPE is used in NVD (National Vulnerability Database) for CVE matching.
